scripts.title: Gun mod (You need the DB shotgun)
scripts.features: It makes your gun OP, you need to have the db equipped to use it tho (it only needs 2 kills)
scripts.script:

yeet.type = "Double Barrel Shotgun" 
yeet.anim_sprint = "sprint_handgun" 
yeet.max_damage = 20 
yeet.min_damage = 1

reload_speed=0.00004
